speedCards.title: No Eloquent overhead
speedCards.desc: Raw SQL only — no model events, no observers, no per-row hydration.

speedCards.title: Bulk inserts
speedCards.desc: Multi-row INSERT statements instead of one query per row.

speedCards.title: Native CSV import
speedCards.desc: LOAD DATA (MySQL) / COPY FROM STDIN (PostgreSQL) for raw throughput.

speedCards.title: Smart chunking
speedCards.desc: Lazy generators keep memory flat, with automatic GC between chunks.

speedCards.title: Minimal overhead
speedCards.desc: FK checks and query logging are disabled automatically during the seed.

speedCards.title: Streaming I/O
speedCards.desc: CSV is piped as a stream and never fully loaded into memory.

features.title: Data Generation
features.desc: Using existing factories or TurboData helpers

features.title: Relational seeding
features.desc: Load FK values in one line, zero queries
